brief: Prioritise Draycott Green for pre-event attention, as units of advanced age with a history of high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure under sustained heat events (MG-023). Because this event runs beyond 48 hours with warm overnight minima, apply the loading reduction from the third day onward as specified in MG-021. Furthermore, run the cooling continuously through the overnight period rather than allowing the thermostat to drop stages out, as the recovery gained overnight is worth more than the fan running cost (MG-025).
